program.name: Plyo EMOM
program.subject: Plyometrics
program.blurb: A few explosive jumps at the top of every minute, the rest of the minute to recover fully.
program.about: Jumps on the clock: a small set of explosive jumps at the top of every minute. The rest of the minute is for recovering fully, which keeps every rep fast. Vertical, broad and lateral jumps and explosive push-ups rotate. A short strength block follows. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps, so the recovery shrinks.
